question: Does the QI local-closure bias identified by C3/C4D causally dominate monotone-phase teacher-forced state-shape error when removed as an exact conservative local error contribution, without free-running oracle substitution?

C4B.firewall: C4E must not repeat free-running flux substitution, clip Se, or reinterpret C4B domain exit as a pass.

authority.reference: same immutable A2 Reference artifact used by C3/C3B/C4D
authority.contribution_identity: unchanged C3 exact additive storage-error contribution vectors

cases.interval_policy: all qualified intervals in each monotone history; no response-driven interval selection

counterfactual_definition.base_local_error: e = y_teacher_end - y_reference_end on the physical reduced state at the same Reference-projected start and prescribed H interval
counterfactual_definition.family_contributions: c_F are the exact C3 additive storage-error vectors satisfying sum_F c_F = e to the frozen hard gate
counterfactual_definition.intervention_semantics: diagnostic endpoint counterfactual only; no modified flux is inserted into Heun substeps and no counterfactual state is propagated to the next interval
counterfactual_definition.conservation: QI, GEOMETRY_GI, Q90 and FIXED_INTERIOR_Q contributions are mass-neutral redistribution terms by construction; QH retains its exact boundary-exchange contribution semantics
counterfactual_definition.physical_admissibility: Every counterfactual endpoint is checked against the unchanged reduced hydraulic-state domain. No clipping, projection repair or fallback is allowed.

secondary: RMS total physical storage endpoint error cm
fraction of intervals with lower shape error than BASE
count of physically inadmissible counterfactual endpoints
metrics.shape_definition: same C3 thickness-weighted mass-removed shape RMS at each interval end geometry

decision_tree.QI_LOCAL_CAUSAL_SUPPORT: For every width, history and dt route, REMOVE_QI is physically admissible, strictly lowers pooled RMS shape error relative to BASE, and has the uniquely lowest pooled RMS shape error among all single-family removals; the best-family identity must agree between the two dt routes.
decision_tree.QI_LOCAL_CAUSAL_MIXED: REMOVE_QI is physically admissible and improves BASE in every case, but is not uniquely best in every width/history/route or route ranking disagrees.
decision_tree.QI_LOCAL_CAUSAL_NOT_SUPPORTED: At least one qualified case has no strict QI improvement while remaining numerically interpretable.
decision_tree.QI_LOCAL_CAUSAL_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: QI counterfactual leaves the qualified physical domain, additive/ledger hard gates fail, or the baseline teacher-forced case is not qualified.

interpretation_firewall: C4E tests one-interval local causal attribution only.
C4E does not show that an oracle-QI free-running model is stable.
C4E does not authorize a fitted QI correction, direction switch, extra memory state or production closure.
If QI support is positive, the next work unit must derive a physically admissible QI reconstruction hypothesis from state/geometry variables before any free propagation.
